  3. Waking up feeling tired: If you are waking up feeling tired, it may be a sign that you are not getting enough sleep or that your sleep is not of good quality.
  4. Feeling drowsy during the day: If you are feeling drowsy during the day, it may be a sign that you are not getting enough sleep or that your sleep is not of good quality.
  5. Feeling irritable or anxious: If you are feeling irritable or anxious, it may be a sign that you are not getting enough sleep or that your sleep is not of good quality.

If you are experiencing any of these warning signs, it is important to seek medical attention to rule out any underlying health conditions. Additionally, if you are experiencing any of these warning signs, it is important to make changes to your sleep habits to improve your sleep quality. This may include establishing a consistent sleep schedule, creating a sleep-conducive environment, and avoiding caffeine and alcohol before bedtime.
